analysis.resampling_unit: whole plant, paired across all arms
analysis.intervals: ordinary percentile95; descriptive fixed generator ensemble; no secondary familywise guarantee
analysis.endpoint_selection: exact trajectory index rounds; later entries ignored
analysis.normalization: each plant terminal true MSE / same plant initial true MSE
analysis.zero_initial_policy: retain plant; normalized endpoint undefined; no filtered ensemble means

learned35_to_oracle_ratio_of_mean_improv.definition: mean learned35 normalized improvement / mean oracle normalized improvement

investment_criteria.interpretation: Half-oracle is the declared point criterion with uncertainty reported separately; all primary target-specific conditions required.
